title: Renormalized Invariant Manifolds
summary: Invariant manifold theory for partial differential equations (PDEs) is technically challenging as we often lack spectral gaps. Motivated by recent progress using renormalization in various areas of mathematics, we introduce a spectral renormalization method for semilinear parabolic equations that creates an artificial spectral gap at high frequencies while leaving the low modes unchanged. For the resulting family of renormalized equations, classical inertial-manifold theory yields finite-dimensional invariant manifolds whose dimension diverges as the renormalization parameter tends to zero.…
